subject: Implementation sprint cartography & MAP — draft for sign-off
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@openhealth.co>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation sprint cartography & MAP — draft for sign-off

Hi Lena / OpenHealth team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — great alignment on the primary objectives. I've attached a first-draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP-draft-openhealth.xlsx) with the implementation sprint cartography: milestone dates, owners, test/validation gates, and the minimal prerequisites we need from your side (sandbox credentials, sample data subset, and PO timing).

High level proposal (please confirm):
- Kickoff: 2026-06-10 (1 hour) — engineering + CS + product sync
- Sandbox provisioned: target 2026-06-11 (OpenHealth IT)
- Integration sprint (2 weeks): 2026-06-12 — 2026-06-25
  - Week 1: connector build + basic inference tests (owner: Redwood infra eng)
  - Week 2: validation + latency QA + cost tuning (owner: Redwood CS)
- Acceptance window: 2026-06-26 — 2026-06-30 (customer acceptance criteria in sheet)

Open items for you:
1) Confirm PO/contract ETA (we noted procurement target 6/18 — will that work?)
2) Who will own sandbox creds from your side? (email for service account provisioning)
3) Any hard blackout dates in June we should avoid?

Next steps: if you can review the MAP + reply with any changes by EOD Thursday (6/03), Monica and I will iterate and send a versioned MAP for sign-off. If this looks good we can lock the kickoff and add a weekly sync cadence.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

--
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: MAP-draft-openhealth.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
From: Lena Park <lena.park@openhealth.co>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2026 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation sprint cartography & MAP — draft for sign-off

Marcus — thanks for the fast turn. Quick notes after a first pass:

- Timeline: 6/10 kickoff works for product and data. We will need to push the acceptance window one week later (target acceptance to 7/07) because our security review is slower in June.
- Procurement: procurement@onyx.com is our vendor team; they're aiming to issue a PO by 6/25, not 6/18. Will that break your internal gating?
- Sandbox creds: I'll own provisioning, will send a service account email by 6/04.
- SOC2 evidence: Can you attach a short index of SOC2 items (audit date, control owner) we can pass to our InfoSec?

Also looping a brief request from IT: any temporary IP allowlist ranges you need us to open? If yes, please include in the next version.

Thanks — Lena
Lena Park
Head of Platform Integrations | OpenHealth Analytics
lena.park@openhealth.co

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Lena Park <lena.park@openhealth.co>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation sprint cartography & MAP — draft for sign-off

Thanks Lena — good questions. Quick internal alignment and proposed updates based on your notes:

1) Acceptance window shift
- We'll move customer acceptance to 2026-07-01 — 2026-07-07 (gives you an extra week for security review).

2) Procurement / PO timing
- PO by 6/25 is acceptable for our Dedicated onboarding pipeline; we will mark the provisioning step as "conditional on signed PO" in the MAP and allow a separate provisioning track if you want a sandbox earlier for dev-only testing (no PII).

3) Networking/IP allowlist
- Temporary allowlist: 34.212.128.0/20 and 52.14.0.0/16 (we'll provide a minimal set in the next doc). If your infra team prefers port lists instead of CIDR we can provide that as well.

4) SOC2 evidence
- Attaching a short index (SOC2-evidence-index.pdf) with control owner and last audit date. We'll provide the full pack under an NDA if requested.

5) Owners and milestones (high-confidence owners):
- Kickoff (6/10) — Marcus (RED) to coordinate attendees
- Sandbox provisioning (6/11) — OpenHealth IT / Lena
- Connector build (6/12–6/18) — Redwood infra eng (Jordan)
- Integration tests + latency tuning (6/19–6/25) — Redwood CS (Monica)
- Acceptance window (7/01–7/07) — OpenHealth product & security

Action items for Marcus: update the MAP to reflect new acceptance dates, mark the provisioning step as conditional on PO, attach SOC2 index, and add the allowlist CIDRs. Once updated send MAP-v1.1 for sign-off and I'll schedule the kickoff meeting.

--
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Lena / team — thank you. Attached is MAP-v1.1.pdf with the agreed updates: acceptance window moved to 7/01–7/07; provisioning step labeled conditional on PO with an optional dev-sandbox track; CIDR allowlist included; SOC2 index attached.

Confirmed next steps and owners:
- Action: Lena to send service account + confirm PO cadence (due 6/25)
- Action: Jordan to begin connector scaffolding on 6/12 (internal kickoff 6/11)
- Action: Monica to own validation tests and acceptance checklist (prep doc by 6/18)

Kickoff meeting: 2026-06-10 10:00am PT (invite to follow)
Weekly sync: Tuesdays 10:00am PT starting 6/16 (30 min)

If there are no further objections we'll treat this as the signed MAP and proceed with scheduling. Please reply-all with a one-line "ACK" when you are good.

Best —
Marcus
